   - **Total WCD** is the sum of queueing delays and propagation/switching/sync delays across all hops.

3. **Hypercycle**:

WCD = \text{(hop\_count × (propagation\_delay + switching\_delay + time\_sync\_error))} + \text{queueing\_delay}
